Run with the real `lint` and `build` over the minimal fixture with the item added: `lint` reports AGSC-E415 for the item and no AGSC-E605; `build` writes a `graph.nq` with no blank node and no triple taken from the block. Supersedes graph-0003. Expected values are derived by hand from the rule text.
